Subject: Private deployment pricing and SOW questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Attached is HelioMed's RFP extract that outlines our commercial constraints and three deployment profiles we're evaluating (pilot single-site, multisite rollout, and on-prem airgapped). Key questions for Redwood: 1) how is the platform fee amortized across commits and invoices? 2) do support tiers include a separate on-call retainer for escalations, or is that part of the ops SKU? 3) can we get a line-item example for seat/node licensing vs. site license for a 12-month and 36-month term?

We're on a tight timetable on this pilot procurement: procurement needs a redline-able SOW and a sample invoice schedule by EOD Friday. Attaching the RFP extract (HelioMed_RFP_20260812.pdf).

Appreciate if you can include any typical concessions for early-adopter pilots (credits, staging discounts).

Best,

Thanks for the RFP and context. We'll put together a redline-ready SOW and a pricing workbook that shows both seat/node and site licensing for 12/36 month terms. Quick clarifications so we size the right offer:

- For the pilot, when you say "single-site" — is that one data center with a max of 4 GPUs for inference and 2 SRE seats for support?

We can typically amortize the platform fee across the commit term (monthly invoices) or charge an up-front platform reservation with monthly ops retainer. I'll pull together two invoice examples.

I'll loop in Marissa (commercial lead) and Mateo (solutions architect) for the workbook and SOW draft. Can you confirm the pilot sizing above by EOD?

Talk soon —

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: HelioMed RFP — pricing posture and amortization options (internal)

Steph / Mateo —

Attaching the pricing matrix draft (pricing_matrix_private_deploy.xlsx). High-level options I recommend:

Option A — Metered + Amortized Platform Fee (12-month)
- Platform fee: $240k/year (amortized $20k/mo)
- Seat/node licenses: $8k/month per GPU node equivalent (4-node pilot = $32k/mo)
- Support: Standard (included for 24x5) ; On-call retainer: $12k/mo (optional)
- Pilot early-adopter credit: 20% first 3 months on platform fee

Option B — Reserved Site License (12-month)
- Site license: $320k/year (covers up to 6 nodes) invoiced quarterly; includes Standard support
- On-call retainer: add $10k/mo if Helio wants on-call SRE coverage
- Pilot concession: one-time $40k implementation credit applied to first invoice

Option C — 36-month blended (best unit economics)
- Platform fee: $600k over 36 months (amortized $16.6k/mo)
- Volume rebate: 10% after year 2 if committed capacity hit

Notes:
- We can be flexible on invoice cadence (monthly, quarterly, or upfront) but volume/term concessions require a commit.
- Airgapped installs incur additional one-time engineering packaging fee ($85k) and longer delivery SLA.

I'm fine with Steph offering a 10% one-time discount on list price for pilot to accelerate procurement.

Attachments: pricing_matrix_private_deploy.xlsx

Marissa
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commercial construct + SOW (pilot) — Redwood / HelioMed

Amir / Lydia —

Thanks for the details. Based on our call and HelioMed's pilot profile, here's a redline-ready proposal to get procurement moving. Attached: Redwood_SOW_HelioMed_20260812.docx and a pricing matrix (pricing_matrix_private_deploy.xlsx). Key points:

- Pilot (single-site, up to 4 GPU nodes): we recommend Option A with amortized platform fee.
  - List pricing (12 months): platform fee $240k (amortized $20k/mo), node license $8k/mo per node (4 nodes = $32k/mo).
  - Support: Standard included (24x5); On-call retainer optional at $12k/mo.
  - Pilot concession: 10% off list platform fee for the first 3 months + one-time $25k implementation credit (applied to first invoice) — limited to pilots executed by Sep 30, 2026.

- Invoice schedule example (amortized): monthly invoices with line items = platform amortization, node licenses, support retainer (if selected), and any one-time credits shown as negative line items on month 1. We can switch to quarterly invoicing if Helio prefers.

- Airgapped deployment (if selected later): separate engineering packaging fee $85k and 8–10 week lead time; estimated additional SOW addendum required.

Next steps: if this aligns, we'll send a redline SOW and a sample invoice schedule (PDF) for procurement. Also looping Mateo for a short implementation milestone plan (cutover, validation window, 30/60/90 support checklist).

If you want to accept the pilot commercial terms in principle, reply to this thread and we'll produce an official quote (DocuSign link) and invoice schedule.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_HelioMed_20260812.docx, pricing_matrix_private_deploy.xlsx
